channel.title: Fire Engineering Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Fire Engineering Magazine (fireengineering.com)

item.title: FAST Rescue Solutions Upgrades FAST Board with New Lower Extremity Strap
item.description: FAST Rescue Solutions has introduced the FAST Lower Extremity Strap for all FAST Boards, replacing the Multi-Loop Strap. This change does not affect existing models or current orders.

item.title: Firefighter Injured Battling Fire at Vacant CA Motel
item.description: A firefighter sustained a lower-body injury while extinguishing a fire at the vacant City Motel in Fresno.

item.title: A Fireworks Store Explosion in China Kills Eight Ahead of Lunar New Year
item.description: An explosion at a fireworks shop in Jiangsu, China, killed eight and injured two, prompting authorities to urge stricter supervision of fireworks use ahead of the Lunar New Year.

item.title: Strong Winds Rip Roof off CA Fire Station
item.description: Strong winds from a thunderstorm damaged a Fresno County fire station, ripping off its roof and affecting the garage. No crews were inside, and service response times remain unaffected.

item.title: OroraTech Appoints Distributed Satellite Pioneer Ignacio Zuleta as CTPO
item.description: OroraTech has appointed Dr. Ignacio Zuleta as CTPO to lead its technology strategy in thermal activity monitoring, enhancing its capabilities in wildfire management and Earth observation systems.

item.title: Dust Explosion at IA Corn Processor Under Investigation
item.description: A dust explosion occurred at Little Sioux Corn Processors in Marcus, Iowa, causing minor injuries. The incident is under investigation, with firefighters managing smoke and heat from the site.

item.title: NC Barn Fire Kills 36 Horses
item.description: A barn fire at Callicutt Stables in Randolph County resulted in the deaths of 36 horses. Firefighters used about 20,000 gallons of water to extinguish the fire.

item.title: Man, 83, Killed in NYC Apartment Fire; Blocked Hydrants Slowed Response
item.description: An 83-year-old man died in a fire at his Queens apartment.

item.title: Four Firefighters, Pastor in Critical Condition After NY Church Explosion
item.description: An explosion at the Abundant Life Fellowship church in Boonville injured five, including a firefighter.

item.title: TIC Use in Window-Initiated Search
item.description: Thomas Anderson of Insight Fire Training considers the use of thermal imaging cameras during window-initiated search.
